description: StorageService — typed MMKV wrapper with get/set/delete/clear, schema migration support
NetworkService — fetch wrapper with timeout, custom headers, abort controller
RetryPolicy + retry execution — exponential backoff (5 attempts, 250ms base), retry on 5xx/network error only
OfflineQueue — persist failed requests to MMKV, drain on reconnect (NetInfo), FIFO order, deduplication
ConfigService — GET config URL, parse snake_case JSON to camelCase types, cache in MMKV with TTL, stale-while-revalidate
ConsentState — category→boolean map, version tracking, serialization to/from MMKV
ConsentResolver — merge server defaults (initialCategories) with local preferences, version bump triggers re-consent
EventEmitter — typed listener registration, removal, dispatch, no memory leaks on unmount
ConsentManager — full orchestrator: initialize flow, public API (isCategoryEnabled, getPreferences, savePreferences, acceptAll, rejectAll, needsConsent, reset), consent service POST
ATT bridge — iOS native module (requestTrackingAuthorization, getTrackingStatus), maps ATT result to consent categories, Android no-op
WebViewConsent — generate consent payload JS string, injection helper for react-native-webview, banner suppression utility
Theme system — extract colors/fonts/spacing/position from config, dark mode support (system preference or config override)
Banner component — config-driven layout, position variants (top/bottom/center/fullscreen), button actions, animations, showBanner() trigger
PreferenceCenter component — category toggles grouped by purpose, save/cancel actions, tracking details expansion, accessibility (VoiceOver/TalkBack labels, focus management)
Integration tests — full lifecycle with real MMKV storage: init → consent check → show banner → save → verify state persisted → offline queue → reconnect → drain
Expo config plugin — auto-configure NSUserTrackingUsageDescription in Info.plist, customizable description string
